com.sun.corba.se.spi.ior

接口 IORTemplate

  • 所有超级接口:
    Collection, IORFactory, Iterable, List, MakeImmutable, Writeable
    所有已知实现类:
    IORTemplateImpl

    public interface IORTemplate
extends List, IORFactory, MakeImmutable
    An IORTemplate provides all of the data necessary to create an IOR except for the typeId and ObjectId. It is a list of TaggedProfileTemplates.
